basic_info.description: Spacious DETACHED corner home in the desirable Inner Sunset, bordering Golden Gate Heights and Forest Hill. Built on a larger lot with plenty of natural lights coming through all sides! Enjoy the best of these sought-after neighborhoods with Grandview Park, Golden Gate Heights Park, JP Murphy Playground, and Inner Sunset's vibrant shops and eateries just blocks away. This bright, detached home features a south-facing living room with high ceilings, a large kitchen connecting to the dining room, four bedrooms, a full bath with separate shower and tub, and an additional half bath all on the top floor. An interior staircase leads to a huge garage with high ceilings, a legal second unit (1890 10th Ave) with a separate side entrance, two-car parking, and additional storage. The ground-floor unit includes a spacious living room, bedrooms, a full bath, a  bath, and a kitchen. A detached garage accessed through the backyard adds extra convenience. Views of Twin Peaks, the bay, Golden Gate Bridge, and Mount Sutro complete this exceptional property!
